metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience at least 45 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need rainfall data for two locations: Mount Isa (~-20.7, 139.5) and Townsville (~-19.3, 146.8) in Queensland, Australia - Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 - Best collection: CHIRPS (daily rainfall) or GPM (3-hourly rainfall) - GPM IMERG provides better temporal resolution: 'NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06' 2. Masking strategy: - This is about rainfall measurement, not clouds - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - Just sum the precipitation over the period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If collection has data and calculations succeed, but total < 450mm → Answer B - If calculations succeed and total ≥ 450mm → Answer A - If collection is empty → C1 - If pixel count is 0 → C2 - If result is None/NaN → C3 - Need to check BOTH locations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.5, -20.7]); const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.8, -19.3]); const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-11'; // Inclusive of Feb 10 // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG (precipitation in mm/hr) const gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filter(ee.Filter.date(startDate, endDate)) .select('precipitation'); const collectionSize = gpm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over time period // GPM data is in mm/hr, so multiply by 0.5 hours (30-min intervals) to get mm per image const totalPrecip = gpm.map(function(img) { return img.multiply(0.5); // Convert mm/hr to mm per 30-min }).sum(); // 4. Calculate for Mount Isa const mountIsaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mountIsaCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const mountIsaRainfall = mountIsaStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 5. Calculate for Townsville const townsvilleStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const townsvilleCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: townsville, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const townsvilleRainfall = townsvilleStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 6. Validation if (mountIsaCount === 0 || townsvilleCount === 0) { console.log(`Mount Isa pixels: ${mountIsaCount}, Townsville pixels: ${townsvilleCount}`); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mountIsaRainfall === null || townsvilleRainfall === null || isNaN(mountIsaRainfall) || isNaN(townsvilleRainfall)) { console.log("Calculation failed - null or NaN result"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Mount Isa total rainfall: ${mountIsaRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Townsville total rainfall: ${townsvilleRainfall.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Threshold: 450 mm (45 cm)`); // 7. Final Answer - BOTH regions need >= 450mm if (mountIsaRainfall >= 450 && townsvilleRainfall >= 450) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
